Lombok ( Saturday - Tuesday ) Start from IDR 4,750,000 Per Person Komodo Tour From Lombok, Embark on a once-in-a-lifetime 4D3N Komodo Tour from Lombok, where the raw beauty of nature, legendary Komodo dragons, and surreal island landscapes await. This isn’t just a trip—it’s a journey into a living postcard. Forget crowded cities and tight itineraries—this adventure is all about slow travel, island vibes, and immersive exploration. Over four days, you’ll hop between iconic destinations like Padar Island, Pink Beach, and Komodo Island, all while soaking in the changing hues of the ocean and sky. Whether you’re a nature lover, photographer, or someone who just wants to escape the ordinary, this is your perfect getaway. Why wait? Let Komodo’s untamed beauty steal your breath away. Komodo Dragons & Wild Encounters What’s a Komodo trip without coming face-to-face with the world’s largest lizards? On this tour, you’ll visit Komodo Island and Rinca Island, guided by expert local rangers who ensure safety and provide fascinating insights into these prehistoric creatures. But the Komodo aren’t the only stars of the show. Along the way, you might spot wild deer, wild boars, eagles, and dolphins cutting through the turquoise waves. These encounters remind you: you’re not in a zoo, you’re in the wild—where nature writes the script. Scenic Spots & Island Hopping Paradise This Komodo tour is packed with Instagram-worthy moments. Hike up to the iconic viewpoint on Padar Island, where three crescent-shaped beaches in different colors stretch below you. Chill on the blushing shores of Pink Beach, where coral fragments tint the sand a dreamlike hue. Or drift in the calm waters of Taka Makassar, a stunning sandbar that seems to float in the middle of nowhere. You’ll travel by comfortable boat, with cozy sleeping arrangements and all meals included. That means more time to enjoy sunsets on the deck, morning coffee with sea views, and starry nights away from the city lights.
